lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Channels, three days west of Ashfall. The strongest fleet the frontier has ever seen. Probably.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: The thing where you stare at the tactical map like it owes you money.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: When this is done and Meridian is safe, I want a month somewhere with weather. Real rain.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: You always say that. You never bring the tea.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Bridge, the seam's purring like a cat. Best ship I've ever worked on.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Bring on the Weave. Missiles, mines, shields, a turret, drones, and a ship that hums. What could go wrong?
